evidenceLineage.origin: 2026-10-09 local Room06 research artifact; persisted without redoing prior mathematics
evidenceLineage.sourceFamily: analytic model, not Taiwan historical observations

title: Reverse FCFF DCF market-implied expectations: non-identification and Taiwan PIT contract

model.type: synthetic two-stage enterprise FCFF, not observed stock evidence
model.requiredDomain: r>gT; r>-1; g>-1; same currency and FCFF definition
model.solver: fixed discount rate and terminal assumptions; root in g; never infer a unique g when r/gT/margins/reinvestment are unknown

hypotheses.claim: Observed enterprise price uniquely identifies required cash-flow growth.
hypotheses.support: Under fixed internally consistent cash flows, r and gT, inverse root can be solved.
hypotheses.counter: Same 1700 EV requires g from -1.27% to +12.85% as r changes 8%-12%; one price underdetermines several unknowns.
hypotheses.alternative: Discount-rate risk premium, terminal duration, margin path, reinvestment intensity, capital structure or non-operating assets.
hypotheses.failure: Any model-input vintage is not fixed at the observation cutoff; multiple/no admissible roots; r<=gT.

hypotheses.support: Conditional on fixed and plausible reinvestment/return assumptions, demanding implied growth is a useful expectation stress.
hypotheses.counter: High incremental return on capital and long competitive-advantage period can justify higher growth; low growth can be a value trap.
hypotheses.alternative: Pricing power, accounting-intangible intensity, cyclicality, capital intensity, risk compensation.
hypotheses.failure: Forecast growth independent of reinvestment/return-on-invested-capital identity or terminal cash flows economically impossible.

hypotheses.claim: Implied growth minus consensus is tradable alpha.
hypotheses.support: A pre-decision PIT expectation gap may represent information disagreement.
hypotheses.counter: Stale/optimistic consensus, timing mismatch, overlapping existing momentum/growth/valuation, trading costs and regime exposure can eliminate incrementality.
hypotheses.alternative: Risk premium, peer shocks, sector mix, stale forecasts and accounting revision.
hypotheses.failure: No authorized pre-decision consensus/guidance vintage or no independent OOS/Shadow evidence.

reinvestmentAndTerminalGuards.identity: Sustainable growth ≈ incremental ROIC × reinvestment rate only under explicit stable-capital-return assumptions; FCFF cannot grow independently of required reinvestment.
reinvestmentAndTerminalGuards.terminalShareInterpretation: ~70%-77% of synthetic EV from terminal value; high sensitivity, not proof of mispricing.
reinvestmentAndTerminalGuards.reject: Do not label high implied g overvaluation without testing margin/ROIC/reinvestment/terminal assumptions; terminal r<=gT is invalid, not infinite positive evidence.
reinvestmentAndTerminalGuards.financialInstitutions: Use D08-18 institution-specific equity/regulatory capital semantics; do not force industrial FCFF/WACC model.

taiwanPitContract.decisionCutoff: fixed market close/observation clock and next tradable session
taiwanPitContract.equityToEnterpriseBridge: Do not treat market capitalization as EV; reconcile cash, debt, leases, minorities, preferred and non-operating items with consistent PIT accounting and ownership scope.
taiwanPitContract.corrections: append-only vintage; later filings do not overwrite earlier knownAt

validationPlan.sample: Predefine Taiwan industrial cohorts across >=2 industries and >=2 dates, include delisted/negative-FCFF/illiquid cases as explicit eligibility or UNKNOWN.
validationPlan.beforeOutcomes: Freeze solver domain, discount/terminal sensitivity grid, share-count bridge, coverage, peer membership, accounting versions, date clusters, control factors and hypothesis count.
controls: raw PE/PB and historical percentiles D08-03
validationPlan.postUnlock: Only after physical PIT and D16 preregistration: purged walk-forward/OOS, clustered by date/issuer, multiple-testing control, after-cost and regime robustness; no historical Shadow fabrication.

exactNext: Freeze 2-industry 2-date Taiwan issuer EV bridge and vintage receipts, stress terminal/ROIC/reinvestment consistency; preserve source/UNKNOWN; no outcome join.
